messages:
sam: Hey — my local quickstart works fine but our CI job that uses the service account is getting a 402 on the first /v1/chat/completions call. Anyone seen this?

maria: can you paste the error body (redact keys)? 402 usually means billing not active for the workspace the token belongs to.

sam: yeah here it is: 
```
HTTP/1.1 402 Payment Required
Content-Type: application/json
{
  \"error\": {
    \"code\": \"workspace.billing_required\",
    \"message\": \"Workspace needs billing set up to make API calls\"
  }
}
```

josh: quick Q — is the token coming from a user login or a service account key? CI should be using a service principal bound to a workspace.

sam: it's the service account key we generated for the repo (SERVICE_KEY_FILE). Locally I'm using my personal API key and that works.

maria: aha. Most common thing: the service account was created under a new workspace that doesn't have billing enabled. Local key is on a different (billed) workspace so it succeeds.

sam: how do I confirm which workspace the service account belongs to?

maria: you can inspect the service account metadata in Console -> Settings -> Service accounts, or run our CLI: `rwctl sa get --id <id>` (will show workspace_id). If that workspace has no payment method you'll hit 402.

sam: verified — the SA is attached to a temporary workspace we spun up during onboarding. That workspace hasn't had billing set up. Oops.

josh: fix options: 1) move the SA to a billed workspace, 2) create a new SA in the org workspace with billing, or 3) attach a payment method to the temp workspace.

sam: moved the SA to our main workspace and restarted CI — pipeline passed! 

maria: thanks for the quick debug. Can we add a doc note in quickstart about service accounts & billing mismatch? I think the error text could also suggest: \"check workspace billing for the token\". Right now it's pretty terse. :thinking: 

josh: filing a small DX ticket and adding a tip to the onboarding guide. Also pinging infra team to see if we can improve the CLI error to include workspace id.

devex-bot: created ticket DEVEX-412: \"Clarify billing error for service accounts in quickstart\" and added to backlog.

oncall-bot: reminder — if this shows up during an oncall, check token->workspace mapping before escalating.

sam: leaving a short comment in the repo README about using org-level SAs. Thanks all :tada:
